responsibility: This header declares the mc front end's filename utility interface. It exports helpers for constructing filenames from module names and extensions, deriving stem names, removing a known extension, and extracting the module/file component from a path, defining the public pathname-manipulation contract used by search and compilation support code.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public filename utility routines used by other mc-boot components. Unlike GmcFileName.cc, it does not implement concatenation, slicing, extension tests, or path splitting.
